mnemonic: When editing a .scdl asset or working with pixel art direction: art genes are human-curated (never auto-generated), projection is deterministic (pure function, no I/O), commit requires interactive human approval (agent strings refused), and the durable ledger is the memory (event emission alone is not enough). SCD64 is an address, not a payload. Feel is warn-only.
retrievalTrigger: file surface matches *.scdl, scdna-art-gene*, project-genes*, art-gene-ledger*, or pixel-art-direction capability queries
